performance.rationale: Reviewed all 18 interleaved frozen-source runs, raw per-run maxima, paired timing/CPU/RSS and executable sizes against the retained M8 native executable. There are no >1.10 median threshold regressions. At 1/4/16 panes the frame mean medians are 337/551/638 us versus M8 337/557/649 us; P95 medians are 350/565/654 versus 350/574/672 us. All runs retain 88771 matches. Maximum search tick across nine candidate runs is 6029 us versus M8 7161 us, with no concealed outlier. Two-second idle CPU medians are 238/273/262 us versus 238/254/268 us; candidate maximum is 309 us. Startup medians are 38/38/38 ms versus 39/38/38 ms. Peak RSS medians increase by 704512/720896/868352 bytes (under 0.5%); process CPU medians are unchanged at 1/4 panes and 0.69 versus 0.68 seconds at 16 panes. The unstripped executable is 15.53% larger as these features and checks were integrated; this size cost is explicitly accepted, without claiming an overall resource improvement. This accepts the measured ui.Tester developer workload only; GPU draw/present, OS window/compositor, GTK/X11, VDI, PSS, Linux runtime and end-to-end sidebar interactions were not measured.
